name: How long does kitchen drywall installation and finishing take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen drywall installation and finishing take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen drywall installation typically takes 3 to 6 days depending on the room size and required finish level. Hanging the gypsum panels usually takes 1 to 2 days. The taping, mudding, and sanding phase requires an additional 2 to 4 days because each coat of joint compound must dry completely before the next application and final sanding. Humid weather or thick coats can extend drying times. Projects that require custom framing adjustments or extensive cutouts for recessed lights and outlets may also take slightly longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen drywall installation and finishing generally takes 3 to 6 days. Hanging boards takes 1 to 2 days, followed by several days for taping, mudding, and drying.
